Commentary.Commentary: Right then! That is it from this game! The action does not stop here though! The game between Australia Women and England Women is spicing up at Seddon Park, Hamilton right now. So switch tabs and enjoy the coverage of that game. Also, we have a cracker of a game coming up on Sunday, 6th March where India Women will lock horns with Pakistan Women. That clash begins at 6.30 am IST (1 am GMT). We look forward to your company for this game and make sure you tune in early for the buildup. Till then, take care and goodbye!

Sune Luus, the winning skipper, says that they had some nervous moments but credits the bowlers for putting up a good show. Tells that everybody complemented each other very well today. Mentions that they have some world class players who showed their experience today, and the bowlers were impressive. Adds that they lost wickets at crucial times and didn't get any partnerships going. Tells that it was still a good effort to get to the 200-run mark but they will need bigger scores in the upcoming games. Ends by saying that they didn't play their best and hopes to do better in the next game.

Nigar Sultana, the skipper of Bangladesh Women, is up for a chat. On being asked about her injury, says that she is fine now. Says that their bowlers did a great job but they should have batted well after the openers provided them with a good start. Mentions that they lost a lot of wickets in the middle overs and that cost them the game. Says that they will take a lot of positives from this game and will look to give their best in the next game.

Ayabonga Khaka is the PLAYER OF THE MATCH. She says that getting to 100 ODI wickets means a lot. She couldn't wait to go in the middle and do the job and is glad that she did it. Tells that she stuck with her lines and lengths and it paid off. Mentions that one should just follow their heart and they'll do well. Credits Bangladesh Women for playing well and says that they bowled well and put them under pressure. Tells that they need to do better in the following games.
... THE PRESENTATION ...

South Africa Women were denied an early breakthrough and they were in a slight spot of bother when Bangladesh Women openers were going along nicely. It was Ayabonga Khaka who provided wickets at a crucial juncture of the game for South Africa Women and brought them back into the contest. She finished with figures of 10-3-32-4. The other bowlers also kept the batters on their toes and hardly gave away any freebies. Masabata Klaas grabbed a couple of wickets while Shabnim Ismail and Marizanne Kapp picked one wicket apiece.

Bangladesh Women got off to a sedate start but the opening pair of Shamima Sultana and Sharmin Akhter ensured that they don't lose wickets early on and kept the scoreboard ticking. However, they didn't score at a good rate and that meant, once Bangladesh Women lost both their openers, it was always going to be an uphill task for them. They lost wickets in a cluster in the middle overs and gave away the momentum. Their skipper, Nigar Sultana and Ritu Moni did try their best to take the game deep but the required rate kept creeping up and that resulted in Bangladesh Women crumbling under pressure. Not the worst outing for them, considering this was their first appearance in the World Cup.

A pretty comfortable victory in the end for South Africa Women and Bangladesh Women would be very disappointed as they were ahead in the game till the 19th over but completely lost the plot once their openers were sent back to the hut. The Proteas weren't at their best either but the brilliance of Ayabonga Khaka has ensured that they start the tournament on a winning note.

The ball hits the pads and ricochets back to disturb the stumps. Bangladesh Women are bundled out for 175. South Africa Women win by 32 runs!

Masabata Klaas does very well to gather it and just flick it to the stumps. The umpire takes it upstairs and the replay shows Nigar Sultana was inches short of her ground. South Africa Women inching closer to the victory.

Short of a length, on middle and leg. Moni mistimes her heave to mid-wicket.

Wonderful bowling! Ismail bowls it full, on leg. Ritu Moni could only work it down to mid on.

Another full ball, outside off. Ritu Moni drives but finds the extra cover fielder this time. 43 runs needed from 30 balls.
A full ball, outside off. Ritu Moni drives it to mid off.

FOUR! SMASHED! 50-run partnership between these two! Bangladesh Women are fighting hard here! Another ball, short and wide, outside off. Ritu Moni stays back and cuts it past point to fetch herself a boundary.
A full toss, on middle. Nigar Sultana skips down and heaves it towards deep mid-wicket for one run.

FIVE WIDES! This is the last thing that South Africa Women would have wanted! Khaka serves a slower ball, well outside off. Nigar Sultana misses her slog. The keeper fails to grab the ball cleanly and the ball races away to the fence.
Back of a length, cramping the batter for room. Ritu Moni stays back and steers it to third man for a run.
A length ball, around off. Nigar Sultana defends it towards point and scampers through to the other end.

Short of a length, outside off. Nigar Sultana guides it towards third man for a single.
A length ball, around off. Ritu Moni defends it towards cover and sets off for a single. Sune Luus runs in from cover, collects the ball but misses her shy at the striker's end.
Back of a length, around off. Nigar Sultana dabs it wide of the point fielder and rotates the strike.
On a length, around off. Nigar Sultana slaps it through the cover region and comes back for the second run.
Around off. Ritu Moni taps it to point for a single.
Chloe Tryon has hurt herself on the fingers. She is going off the field to get some treatment.

DROPPED! A very tough chance though! A full ball, outside off. Nigar Sultana drills it straight back to the bowler. Ayabonga Khaka sticks her left hand out and gets some fingertips to it. The ball deflects towards the mid off fielder and that fielder half-stops it. Two runs taken.

Back of a length, around off. Ritu Moni taps it towards cover.
Full and wide, outside off. Nigar Sultana slices it towards third man and takes a run.
A length ball that jags back in from off. Nigar Sultana defends it out.
Wide! Khaka sprays it down leg. Nigar Sultana lets it be. Wided!
A full ball, outside off. Ritu Moni drives it to the cover fielder.
A slower ball, full and around off. Ritu Moni looks to drive but it goes off the outside edge towards third man for a run. 71 runs needed off 48 balls.
FOUR! CUT AWAY! Back of a length and well outside off. Ritu Moni cuts it past the point fielder to bag a boundary.
Another ball, short and outside off. Ritu Moni cuts it straight to the point fielder.
Short of a length, outside off. Ritu Moni looks to cut but she fails to get any blade on it.
On a length, around off. Ritu Moni pushes it towards cover.
Back of a length, on off. Ritu Moni blocks it off the back foot.
Pitches it up, around middle. Ritu Moni tucks it to the leg side and settles for a single.

Fuller in length, on off. Sultana drives it through covers for a single.

Fuller in length, on off. Moni drives it towards covers.

On a length, on middle. Moni taps it towards covers.
Lovely delivery! Right into the blockhole, on leg. Ritu Moni digs it out.
Fuller in length, outside off. Moni steers it to deep point and crosses ends.
Length ball, outside off. Sultana dabs it down to third man for a run.
On a length, on off. Sultana pushes it to mid off.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Yes, Khaka gets her 100th ODI wicket straightaway and what a day she is having! She comes back into the attack and gets the breakthrough for her side. Ayabonga Khaka becomes the fifth South African to claim 100 wickets in this format and also the second-fastest South African behind Shabnim Ismail. Now coming to the ball - This was a length ball, just outside off and nipping back in slightly. Rumana Ahmed looks to drive away from her body and it goes off the inside edge towards the keeper. Trisha Chetty makes no mistake and Bangladesh Women lose their fifth wicket.
Commentary.Howout: c Trisha Chetty b Ayabonga Khaka

Commentary.Commentary: Drinks! Bangladesh Women need 100 runs in 16 overs and 6 wickets in hand as well but the required rate is creeping up now and they need to shift gears. South Africa Women would be happy at the moment and would not want to let the momentum shift. Ayabonga Khaka (6-2-9-3) is back into the attack. Can she get her 100th ODI wicket?

Kapp goes full and around middle. Nigar Sultana pushes it towards mid on.

Around off. Rumana Ahmed blocks it out.

Back of a length, around middle. Nigar Sultana hangs back and dabs it onto the deck.

A full ball, outside off. Rumana Ahmed shoulders her arms at this one.
Good-length ball, on middle. Nigar Sultana nudges it towards deep square leg for a single.
Flatter and quicker, outside off. Nigar Sultana rocks back and cuts it past point for a run.
Tossed up, on off. Nigar Sultana defends it to the off side.

Sultana finally finding a way to get a single. Steers this length ball to third man. 117 needed frm 120 balls.
On a length, around off. Sultana taps it to point.
Good-length ball, on middle. Sultana solidly blocks it out
Beauty! Short of a length, on middle. Sultana sways away from the line and lets it go.
Short of a length, outside off. Nigar Sultana goes for the pull but misses.
Good-length ball, on off. Sultana covers the line and defends it under her eyes.
This is pushed towards covers by Rumana Ahmed.

OUT! RUN OUT! Bangladesh Women losing wickets quickly here. Flighted delivery, on off. Rumana Ahmed looks to push it but gets an outside edge to short third man. The batters take off for a quick single. Masabata Klaas collects the ball and hits the bullseye at the striker's end. South Africa Women are confident but the umpire take it upstairs. One look is enough for the third umpire to declare Fargana Hoque out. Masabata Klaas showing some 'CLASS' in the field.
Is that a run out? A direct hit at the striker's end and Fargana Hoque seems to be in trouble. The decision has been sent upstairs and the replay shows that Fargana Hoque is well short of her crease.
Length ball, on leg. Ahmed clips it to square leg for one. A better over for Bangladesh Women. 7 off it.
Fuller in length, on off. Ahmed drives it towards covers.

On a length, on off. Ahmed blocks it to the off side for a run.

FOUR! In the gap! Fuller, outside off. Rumana Ahmed creams it through covers. The timing was excellent on that one and gets a boundary.

On a length, on middle. Rumana Ahmed drags it to deep square leg for a run.

Floated, full and on off. Fargana Hoque blocks it with ease.
Tossed up, around off. Fargana Hoque gets solid in her front foot defence.
Floated, on a length, outside off. Fargana Hoque guides it towards short third man.
Flatter ball, outside off. Fargana Hoque cuts it to point.
On a length, around off. Rumana Ahmed blocks it.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Ayabonga Khaka IS ON A ROLL! She gets her third wicket and Bangladesh Women are falling apart here! Khaka serves a full ball, outside off, drawing the batter to drive. Murshida Khatun looks to push it through the off side but it goes off the outside edge to the left of the keeper. Trisha Chetty moves there and takes it with ease. South Africa Women have made a roaring comeback into this contest.

Drinks! Bangladesh Women have really weathered the storm and are growing in confidence. The opening pair have also brought up the 50-run stand and will look to continue on their merry way. South Africa Women desperately need a wicket here to get some momentum.
Tossed up, on off. Shamima Sultana keeps it out.

FOUR! Nicely played! This is turning out to be a really good over for Bangladesh Women! Tossed up, around middle. Shamima Sultana kneels and sweeps it through the square leg region to bag another boundary.
Flatter ball, around off. Sharmin Akhter taps it towards point and takes a single.
FOUR! Punished by Akhter! Dragged down, around middle. Sharmin Akhter rocks back and pulls it wide of the deep mid-wicket fielder for a boundary.
A loopy full toss, outside off. Sharmin Akhter pushes it towards cover.
A loopy ball, around leg. Sharmin Akhter misses her sweep and gets hit low on her pad.
A full ball, on middle. Shamima Sultana tucks it to mid-wicket.
Fuller in length, around middle and leg. Sharmin Akhter tickles it to fine leg for a single. 50 comes up for Bangladesh Women!
Good-length delivery, outside off. Sharmin Akhter punches it to the cover fielder.
A length ball, darted on the pads. Sharmin Akhter tucks it behind square on the leg side and comes back for the second run.
Pitches it up, around off. Sharmin Akhter drives but straight to the cover fielder.
Back of a length, outside off. Sharmin Akhter looks to cut but she misses.
Flighted ball, around off. Sultana pats it back to the bowler.
A full toss just below the waist height, on middle. Sharmin Akhter pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Loopy ball, on off. Akhter drives it but straight to mid off.
Floats it up, on off. Akhter defends it back to the bowler.
WIDE! Short and way too outside off. Left alone. Wided.
Slower through the air, on off. Sultana sweeps it to deep square leg for a single.
Starts with a yorker, on off. Sultana digs it out.
Sune Luus brings herself into the attack now.
On the pads, flicked to square leg.
A wide yorker, outside off. Akhter squeezes it out to backward point.
Short ball, on middle. Sharmin Akhter pulls it through mid-wicket. Didn't time it well at all but will get two runs.
On a good length, on off. Akhter defends it out.
On a good length, around off. Defended back to the bowler.

A tight single! Length ball, outside off. Shamima Sultana drives it towards covers. The fielder quickly gets across to ger right and throws the ball at the bowler's end. A direct hit and Sultana was a goner.
Short of a length, on middle and leg. Akhter shows full face of the bat and blocks it right under her eyes.
On a good length, on off. Akhter gets an under-edge back to the bowler.
Outside off, guided to third man for one.
FOUR! Up and over! Length, pushed wider, outside off. Shamima Sultana slices it over point. The ball races away to the boundary in a flash. Bangladesh Women growing in confidence now.
Fuller in length, on off. Sultana drives it towards covers.
Good-length ball, on off. Sharmin Akhter looks to punch. The ball goes off the inside edge to square leg for a single.
A full ball, on middle. Sharmin Akhter flicks it to deep square leg for a single.
A yorker, around middle. Shamima Sultana looks to dig it out. It takes the thick inside edge towards fine leg for a single.
Good-length delivery, around off. Sharmin Akhter pushes it towards cover.
A length ball, around middle. Sharmin Akhter looks to block but it goes off the inner half towards mid-wicket for a run.
FOUR! Lovely stroke! In the slot, outside off. Sharmin Akhter was looking for this length. She leans and drives it through covers for a glorious boundary.
A yorker, around off. Sharmin Akhter tries to drive but the ball goes off the toe end of the bat back to the keeper. The ball was very close from hitting the off pole.
Fuller, outside off. Pushed to cover.
On a length, on leg. Akhter misses her flick. The ball brushes her pads and goes to fine leg for a leg bye.
Fuller in length, on off. Akhter stands tall and drives it to mid on.
Full and on leg, Akhter looks to flick but misses and gets hit on the pads.
Play and a miss! Full again, outside off. Akhter looks to drive but gets beaten.
Fuller in length, outside off. Akhter drives it towards covers.
A maiden! Good-length ball, on off. Shamima Sultana stays solid in her defence.
Good-length ball, on off. Sultana defends it off the front foot.
Touch fuller, on off. Sultana drives it towards covers.
Length ball, on off. Sultana plays it uppishly to extra cover.
Full, angling in to the right-hander. Shamima Sultana works it to mid on.
Fuller in length, on off. Sultana presses forward and defends it to the off side.
Length ball, outside off. Pushed towards covers.
Fuller, on off. Driven towards covers.
On a good length, on off. Akhter stays back and blocks.
Fuller and pushed wider, outside off. Sharmin Akhter tries to drive but gets beaten.
Length ball, on the pads. Sultana clips it behind square on the leg side for a single.
Fuller in length, on off. Shamima Sultana drives it back to Khaka.
Length ball, attacking the stumps. Akhter defends it back to the bowler.
Good-length ball, on middle. Defended out.

FOUR! Still no third slip and once again, the ball beats the second slip and races away. Fuller, on off. Sharmin Akhter looks to drive but the ball goes off the outside edge past the seond slip fielder for a boundary.
Full and wide, outside off. Akhter looks to drive but gets beaten on the outside edge.
On the pads, tucked to square leg for a run.
Good-length ball, outside off. Shamima Sultana looks to cut it away but misses.
Short of a length, outside off. Sharmin Akhter pushes it to the off side. A maiden for Ayabonga Khaka!
Length ball, on middle. Pushed to mid on.
Full and outside off, Sharmin Akhter goes for the booking drive but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Touch fuller, on middle. Akhter pushes it back to the bowler.
Length ball, angling in, Sharmin Akhter looks to flick but gets an inside edge. The ball lobs right in front of her.
Ayabonga Khaka comes into the attack.
On a good length, outside off. Sharmin Akhter chases after but fails to connect.
On a good length, shaping away, outside off. Sultana leaves it for the keeper to collect.
Fuller in length, outside off. Sultana chases after it but misses.
TWO WIDES! On a length, down the leg side. Sharmin Akhter looks to tuck but misses. The keeper fails to collect it cleanly and the batters take a single.
Just short! Length ball, outside off. Sharmin Akhter prods and cuts it to point where the ball falls just short of Laura Wolvaardt.
Good-length ball, shaping away, outside off. Sharmin Akhter hangs her bat out but decides not to offer anything in the end.
Wide outside off, Sultana cuts it past point for a single.
Length ball, outside off. Sultana pushes it to cover.
WIDE! On a length, wide outside off. Shamima Sultana has a slash but misses. Wide called.
Yet another bouncer from Ismail, around middle. Sharmin Akhter ducks underneath.
Another bumper, on middle. Shamima Sultana looks to pull hard but she mistimes it wide of the mid-wicket fielder and the batters take a single.

No ball! Banged into the deck, on middle. Shamima Sultana miscues her pull wide of the mid-wicket fielder for a single. Shabnim Ismail oversteps yet again and the umpire signals a no ball. Free Hit to follow.
On a length, outside off. Shamima Sultana leans and drives it past the mid off fielder for a brace.
Fuller in length, outside off. Shamima Sultana drives it towards the mid off fielder.

DROPPED! Back of a length, outside off. Sharmin Akhter hangs back and cuts it uppishly towards the point fielder where Laura Wolvaardt hops and looks to grab it with one hand but she makes a mess of it.
A half-volley, outside off. Sharmin Akhter throws her bat at it and it goes off the outer half of the blade through the cover region for a couple of runs.
Back of a length, outside off. Shamima Sultana leaves it alone.
Good-length ball, on off. Sharmin Akhter looks to defend but it goes off the outside edge towards third man for a single.
Drags her length back a bit and pitches it just outside off. Sharmin Akhter looks to defend off the front foot but the ball zips past her outside edge.
Fuller in length, well outside off. Sharmin Akhter looks for a booming drive but she misses.
Pitches it up, outside off. Sharmin Akhter has a wild swing at it but she misses.
BEATEN! A length ball, angling in from off and shaping away a bit. Sharmin Akhter hangs back to block but the ball beats her outside edge.

In the air but safe! A short ball, around off. Sharmin Akhter stays back and looks to ramp it over the slip cordon but she miscues her shot and the ball lands just wide of the slip fielder. A single taken.
Nicely driven but for no run! Full and outside off. Sharmin Akhter drives but straight to the cover fielder.
Good-length delivery, outside off. Sharmin Akhter pushes it towards cover.
Sharmin Akhter backs away and gets followed by a bumper. Akhter fails to get any bat on it as she tries to cut it.
No Ball! On a length, around middle. Sharmin Akhter keeps it out. Shabnim Ismail oversteps and the umpire calls it no ball. Free Hit to follow.

FOUR! EDGY! Had there been a third slip in place, it would have been curtains for Sharmin Akhter. A length ball, around off that curls away after landing. Akhter looks to poke but it goes off the outside edge past the second slip fielder and into the fence.
A full ball, angling in from middle. Sharmin Akhter covers the line and pushes it towards mid on.
A length ball, outside off and shaping away from the batter. Shamima Sultana does not bother playing at that one.
Another ball, on a length and outside off. Shamima Sultana sways away from the line of the ball.
Back of a length, well outside off. Shamima Sultana leaves it alone.
On a length, around off. Shamima Sultana blocks it out.
Good-length delivery, around middle. Sharmin Akhter looks to defend but it goes off the thick inside edge towards fine leg for a run.
A length ball, on middle. Shamima Sultana drags it behind square on the leg side and takes a single.
Marizanne Kapp to bowl from the other end.
Back of a length, around off. Sharmin Akhter hangs back to defend.
Short of a length, around off. Sharmin Akhter keeps it out.
Another ball, full and outside off. Sharmin Akhter looks for a drive but the ball zips past her outside edge.
On a length, around middle and leg. Shamima Sultana tucks it around the corner and collects a run. Bangladesh Women are underway!
BEATEN! Good-length ball, just outside off and shaping away late. Shamima Sultana has a poke at it but the ball beats her outside edge.
Ismail starts with a full ball, on middle. Shamima Sultana blocks it out.
